title: Framework and PBC completed pullbacks with their scalar comparisons agree for an arbitrary morphism
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and finite extensions $E\subset L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a fixed algebraic closure, with valuation rings and uniformizers [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $h:T\to U$ be a morphism of schemes, each Noetherian of finite Krull dimension with $\ell$ invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For $D=E,L$ and $W=T,U$ let $\mathcal C^{\mathrm{sf}}_D(W)$ be the framework derived-complete constructible category over $R_{D,W}=\varprojlim_n(\mathcal O_D/\varpi_D^n)_W$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], let $\mathcal C^{\mathrm{pbc}}_D(W)$ be the PBC bounded constructible complete category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], and let $J_{W,D}:\mathcal C^{\mathrm{sf}}_D(W)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal C^{\mathrm{pbc}}_D(W)$ be the coefficient-presentation equivalence inverse to $\Phi_{D,W}$ of [def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport], restricted to these full categories. Write $F^{\mathrm{sf}}_{h,D}$ for the integral derived pullback of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], computed by the strict reduction-tower model of [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], and $F^{\mathrm{pbc}}_{h,D}=Lh^*_{\mathrm{comp}}$ for the completed pullback of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback].

(1) There are natural isomorphisms $\pi_{h,D}:J_{T,D}F^{\mathrm{sf}}_{h,D}\xrightarrow{\sim}F^{\mathrm{pbc}}_{h,D}J_{U,D}$ which, on every flat-term K-flat representative $P$ of $K$, are the realization of the identity of the common strict tower $\operatorname{Res}_nh_n^*\bigl(P\otimes_{R_{D,U}}(\mathcal O_D/\varpi_D^n)_U\bigr)$ with its actual quotient transitions; in particular each derived-limit projection of the source corresponds to the completed projection of the target. They commute with the canonical shift comparisons, are the unit identifications for $h=\mathrm{id}$, and for $g:U\to V$ satisfy
$$c^{\mathrm{pbc}}_{h,g}J\circ\pi_{gh}=F^{\mathrm{pbc}}_h(\pi_g)\circ\pi_{h,F^{\mathrm{sf}}_g}\circ J(c^{\mathrm{sf}}_{h,g}),$$
where $c^{\mathrm{sf}},c^{\mathrm{pbc}}:F_{gh}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_hF_g$ are the specified pullback composition comparisons of the two presentations.

(2) Let $S_W=S_{L/E,W}$ be strict-tower integral scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] and $a_h:S_TF^{\mathrm{sf}}_{h,E}\xrightarrow{\sim}F^{\mathrm{sf}}_{h,L}S_U$ the pullback scalar comparison of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension]. Let $C_W$ be the ordinary scalar extension over the completed coefficient sheaves and $p_h:C_TF^{\mathrm{pbc}}_{h,E}\xrightarrow{\sim}F^{\mathrm{pbc}}_{h,L}C_U$ the completed pullback comparison of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension], normalized as follows. If $\delta_h:F^{\mathrm{ord}}_{h,L}C_U\xrightarrow{\sim}C_TF^{\mathrm{ord}}_{h,E}$ is ordinary pullback/tensor balancing (where $F^{\mathrm{ord}}$ denotes ambient uncompleted derived module pullback), then
$$p_h=(\widehat\delta_h)^{-1}=\Lambda_{T,L}(\delta_h)^{-1}\circ\kappa_{T,F^{\mathrm{ord}}_{h,E}(-)},\qquad \widehat\delta_h=\kappa_T^{-1}\circ\Lambda_{T,L}(\delta_h),$$
using [lem-weil-pbc-reflected-adjunction-coefficient-squares] and $\kappa$ of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-free-completion-transport]. Thus $p_h$ has the displayed direction $C_TF^{\mathrm{pbc}}_{h,E}\to F^{\mathrm{pbc}}_{h,L}C_U$. Let $j_W:J_{W,L}S_W\xrightarrow{\sim}C_WJ_{W,E}$ be the inverse of the completion comparison $\chi_{L/E}$ of [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison], composed with the scalar-presentation comparison of [def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport]. Then for every $K\in\mathcal C^{\mathrm{sf}}_E(U)$
$$F^{\mathrm{pbc}}_{h,L}(j_{U,K})\circ\pi_{h,L,S_UK}\circ J_{T,L}(a_{h,K})=p_{h,J_{U,E}K}\circ C_T(\pi_{h,E,K})\circ j_{T,F^{\mathrm{sf}}_{h,E}K}.$$

(3) For $M,N\in\mathcal C^{\mathrm{sf}}_E(W)$, with the completed tensor product of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and the tensor scalar comparison $a^{\otimes}_{M,N}:S_W(M\widehat\otimes N)\xrightarrow{\sim}S_WM\widehat\otimes S_WN$ of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension], let $\tau^J_{D,M,N}:J_{W,D}(M\widehat\otimes N)\xrightarrow{\sim}J_{W,D}M\widehat\otimes J_{W,D}N$ be the coefficient-relabeling tensor comparison, normalized by the identity on balanced finite-quotient tensors followed by strict-tower realization. Then
$$(j_M\widehat\otimes j_N)\circ\tau^J_{L,S_WM,S_WN}\circ J(a^{\otimes}_{M,N})\circ j_{M\widehat\otimes N}^{-1}\circ C_W((\tau^J_{E,M,N})^{-1})$$
is the canonical tensor scalar comparison $C_W(JM\widehat\otimes JN)\to C_WJM\widehat\otimes C_WJN$: on flat-term K-flat representatives it is the balanced map $(x\otimes y)\otimes s\mapsto(x\otimes s)\otimes(y\otimes1)$ followed by the completion comparisons.

(4) The isomorphisms $\pi$ and $j$ and the equations of (1)-(3) respect the canonical shift comparisons, the unit identifications for $L=E$, and, for $E\subset F\subset L$, the successive-extension tensor associators. They pass to the raw rationalizations [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, def-weil-pbc-rational-category] as the localized natural isomorphisms satisfying the same equations. No flatness of $\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n\to\mathcal O_L/\varpi_L^n$ and no base-change invertibility is asserted.
